lines.text: Here.

lines.speaker: HOTSPUR
lines.text: This, Douglas? No, I know this face full well.

lines.speaker: HOTSPUR
lines.text: A gallant knight he was, his name was Blunt,

lines.speaker: HOTSPUR
lines.text: Semblably furnish’d like the King himself.

lines.speaker: DOUGLAS
lines.text: A fool go with thy soul, whither it goes!

lines.speaker: DOUGLAS
lines.text: A borrow’d title hast thou bought too dear.

lines.speaker: DOUGLAS
lines.text: Why didst thou tell me that thou wert a king?

lines.speaker: HOTSPUR
lines.text: The King hath many marching in his coats.

lines.speaker: DOUGLAS
lines.text: Now, by my sword, I will kill all his coats;

lines.speaker: DOUGLAS
lines.text: I’ll murder all his wardrobe, piece by piece,

lines.speaker: DOUGLAS
lines.text: Until I meet the King.

lines.speaker: HOTSPUR
lines.text: Up, and away!

lines.speaker: HOTSPUR
lines.text: Our soldiers stand full fairly for the day.
[_Exeunt._]
Alarums. Enter Falstaff solus.

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: Though I could scape shot-free at London, I fear the shot here. Here’s

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: no scoring but upon the pate.—Soft! who are you? Sir Walter Blunt.

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: There’s honour for you. Here’s no vanity. I am as hot as molten lead,

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: and as heavy too. God keep lead out of me, I need no more weight than

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: mine own bowels. I have led my ragamuffins where they are peppered.

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: There’s not three of my hundred and fifty left alive, and they are for

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: the town’s end, to beg during life. But who comes here?
Enter Prince Henry.

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: What, stand’st thou idle here? Lend me thy sword.

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: Many a nobleman lies stark and stiff

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: Under the hoofs of vaunting enemies,

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: Whose deaths are yet unrevenged. I prithee

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: Lend me thy sword.

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: O Hal, I prithee give me leave to breathe awhile. Turk Gregory never

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: did such deeds in arms as I have done this day. I have paid Percy, I

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: have made him sure.

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: He is indeed, and living to kill thee.

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: I prithee, lend me thy sword.

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: Nay, before God, Hal, if Percy be alive, thou gett’st not my sword; but

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: take my pistol, if thou wilt.

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: Give it me. What, is it in the case?

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: Ay, Hal, ’tis hot, ’tis hot. There’s that will sack a city.
[_The Prince draws out a bottle of sack._]

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: What, is it a time to jest and dally now?
[_Throws it at him, and exit._]

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: Well, if Percy be alive, I’ll pierce him. If he do come in my way, so;

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: if he do not, if I come in his willingly, let him make a carbonado of

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: me. I like not such grinning honour as Sir Walter hath. Give me life,

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: which if I can save, so: if not, honour comes unlooked for, and there’s

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: an end.
[_Exit._]
Alarums. Excursions. Enter King Henry, Prince Henry, Lancaster and Westmoreland.

lines.speaker: KING
lines.text: I prithee, Harry, withdraw thyself, thou bleedest too much.

lines.speaker: KING
lines.text: Lord John of Lancaster, go you with him.

lines.speaker: LANCASTER
lines.text: Not I, my lord, unless I did bleed too.

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: I do beseech your Majesty, make up,

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: Lest your retirement do amaze your friends.

lines.speaker: KING
lines.text: I will do so. My Lord of Westmoreland,

lines.speaker: KING
lines.text: Lead him to his tent.

lines.speaker: WESTMORELAND
lines.text: Come, my lord, I’ll lead you to your tent.

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: Lead me, my lord? I do not need your help,

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: And God forbid a shallow scratch should drive

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: The Prince of Wales from such a field as this,

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: Where stain’d nobility lies trodden on,

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: And rebels’ arms triumph in massacres!

lines.speaker: LANCASTER
lines.text: We breathe too long. Come, cousin Westmoreland,

lines.speaker: LANCASTER
lines.text: Our duty this way lies. For God’s sake, come.
[_Exeunt Lancaster and Westmoreland._]

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: By Heaven, thou hast deceived me, Lancaster,

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: I did not think thee lord of such a spirit.

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: Before, I loved thee as a brother, John,

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: But now I do respect thee as my soul.

lines.speaker: KING
lines.text: I saw him hold Lord Percy at the point

lines.speaker: KING
lines.text: With lustier maintenance than I did look for

lines.speaker: KING
lines.text: Of such an ungrown warrior.

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: O, this boy

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: Lends mettle to us all!
[_Exit._]
Enter Douglas.

lines.speaker: DOUGLAS
lines.text: Another king! They grow like Hydra’s heads.

lines.speaker: DOUGLAS
lines.text: I am the Douglas, fatal to all those

lines.speaker: DOUGLAS
lines.text: That wear those colours on them. What art thou

lines.speaker: DOUGLAS
lines.text: That counterfeit’st the person of a king?

lines.speaker: KING
lines.text: The King himself, who, Douglas, grieves at heart

lines.speaker: KING
lines.text: So many of his shadows thou hast met,

lines.speaker: KING
lines.text: And not the very King. I have two boys

lines.speaker: KING
lines.text: Seek Percy and thyself about the field,

lines.speaker: KING
lines.text: But, seeing thou fall’st on me so luckily,

lines.speaker: KING
lines.text: I will assay thee, and defend thyself.

lines.speaker: DOUGLAS
lines.text: I fear thou art another counterfeit,

lines.speaker: DOUGLAS
lines.text: And yet, in faith, thou bearest thee like a king.

lines.speaker: DOUGLAS
lines.text: But mine I am sure thou art, whoe’er thou be,

lines.speaker: DOUGLAS
lines.text: And thus I win thee.

lines.speaker: DOUGLAS
lines.text: They fight; the King being in danger, enter Prince Henry.

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: Hold up thy head, vile Scot, or thou art like

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: Never to hold it up again! The spirits

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: Of valiant Shirley, Stafford, Blunt are in my arms.

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: It is the Prince of Wales that threatens thee,

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: Who never promiseth but he means to pay.
[_They fight. Douglas flies._]

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: Cheerly, my lord. How fares your Grace?

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: Sir Nicholas Gawsey hath for succour sent,

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: And so hath Clifton. I’ll to Clifton straight.

lines.speaker: KING
lines.text: Stay and breathe awhile.

lines.speaker: KING
lines.text: Thou hast redeem’d thy lost opinion,

lines.speaker: KING
lines.text: And show’d thou mak’st some tender of my life,

lines.speaker: KING
lines.text: In this fair rescue thou hast brought to me.

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: O God, they did me too much injury

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: That ever said I hearken’d for your death.

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: If it were so, I might have let alone

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: The insulting hand of Douglas over you,

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: Which would have been as speedy in your end

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: As all the poisonous potions in the world,

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: And saved the treacherous labour of your son.

lines.speaker: KING
lines.text: Make up to Clifton. I’ll to Sir Nicholas Gawsey.
[_Exit._]
Enter Hotspur.

lines.speaker: HOTSPUR
lines.text: If I mistake not, thou art Harry Monmouth.

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: Thou speak’st as if I would deny my name.

lines.speaker: HOTSPUR
lines.text: My name is Harry Percy.

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: Why then I see

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: A very valiant rebel of the name.

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: I am the Prince of Wales; and think not, Percy,

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: To share with me in glory any more.

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: Two stars keep not their motion in one sphere,

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: Nor can one England brook a double reign,

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: Of Harry Percy and the Prince of Wales.

lines.speaker: HOTSPUR
lines.text: Nor shall it, Harry, for the hour is come

lines.speaker: HOTSPUR
lines.text: To end the one of us, and would to God

lines.speaker: HOTSPUR
lines.text: Thy name in arms were now as great as mine!

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: I’ll make it greater ere I part from thee,

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: And all the budding honours on thy crest

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: I’ll crop to make a garland for my head.

lines.speaker: HOTSPUR
lines.text: I can no longer brook thy vanities.
[_They fight._]
Enter Falstaff.

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: Well said, Hal! To it, Hal! Nay, you shall find no boy’s play here, I

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: can tell you.
Enter Douglas. He fights with Falstaff, who falls down as if he were dead, and exit Douglas. The Prince kills Hotspur.

lines.speaker: HOTSPUR
lines.text: O Harry, thou hast robb’d me of my youth!

lines.speaker: HOTSPUR
lines.text: I better brook the loss of brittle life

lines.speaker: HOTSPUR
lines.text: Than those proud titles thou hast won of me;

lines.speaker: HOTSPUR
lines.text: They wound my thoughts worse than thy sword my flesh.

lines.speaker: HOTSPUR
lines.text: But thoughts, the slaves of life, and life, time’s fool,

lines.speaker: HOTSPUR
lines.text: And time, that takes survey of all the world,

lines.speaker: HOTSPUR
lines.text: Must have a stop. O, I could prophesy,

lines.speaker: HOTSPUR
lines.text: But that the earthy and cold hand of death

lines.speaker: HOTSPUR
lines.text: Lies on my tongue. No, Percy, thou art dust,

lines.speaker: HOTSPUR
lines.text: And food for—
[_Dies._]

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: For worms, brave Percy. Fare thee well, great heart!

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: Ill-weaved ambition, how much art thou shrunk!

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: When that this body did contain a spirit,

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: A kingdom for it was too small a bound;

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: But now two paces of the vilest earth

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: Is room enough. This earth that bears thee dead

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: Bears not alive so stout a gentleman.

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: If thou wert sensible of courtesy,

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: I should not make so dear a show of zeal.

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: But let my favours hide thy mangled face;

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: And even in thy behalf I’ll thank myself

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: For doing these fair rites of tenderness.

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: Adieu, and take thy praise with thee to heaven!

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: Thy ignominy sleep with thee in the grave,

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: But not remember’d in thy epitaph!
[_Sees Falstaff on the ground._]

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: What, old acquaintance, could not all this flesh

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: Keep in a little life? Poor Jack, farewell!

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: I could have better spared a better man.

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: O, I should have a heavy miss of thee

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: If I were much in love with vanity.

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: Death hath not struck so fat a deer today,

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: Though many dearer, in this bloody fray.

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: Embowell’d will I see thee by and by,

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: Till then in blood by noble Percy lie.
[_Exit._]

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: Falstaff rises up.

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: Embowell’d! If thou embowel me today, I’ll give you leave to powder me

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: and eat me too tomorrow. ’Sblood, ’twas time to counterfeit, or that

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: hot termagant Scot had paid me scot and lot too. Counterfeit? I lie, I

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: am no counterfeit. To die, is to be a counterfeit, for he is but the

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: counterfeit of a man who hath not the life of a man: but to counterfeit

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: dying, when a man thereby liveth, is to be no counterfeit, but the true

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: and perfect image of life indeed. The better part of valour is

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: discretion, in the which better part I have saved my life. Zounds, I am

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: afraid of this gunpowder Percy, though he be dead. How if he should

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: counterfeit too, and rise? By my faith, I am afraid he would prove the

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: better counterfeit. Therefore I’ll make him sure, yea, and I’ll swear I

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: killed him. Why may not he rise as well as I? Nothing confutes me but

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: eyes, and nobody sees me. Therefore, sirrah, with a new wound in your

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: thigh, come you along with me.
[_Takes Hotspur on his back._]
Enter Prince Henry and Lancaster.

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: Come, brother John, full bravely hast thou flesh’d

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: Thy maiden sword.

lines.speaker: LANCASTER
lines.text: But soft, whom have we here?

lines.speaker: LANCASTER
lines.text: Did you not tell me this fat man was dead?

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: I did; I saw him dead,

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: Breathless and bleeding on the ground.—Art thou alive?

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: Or is it fantasy that plays upon our eyesight?

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: I prithee, speak, we will not trust our eyes

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: Without our ears. Thou art not what thou seem’st.

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: No, that’s certain, I am not a double man. But if I be not Jack

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: Falstaff, then am I a Jack. There is Percy!
[_Throwing the body down._]

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: If your father will do me any honour, so; if not, let him kill the next

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: Percy himself. I look to be either earl or duke, I can assure you.

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: Why, Percy I kill’d myself, and saw thee dead.

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: Didst thou? Lord, Lord, how this world is given to lying! I grant you I

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: was down and out of breath, and so was he, but we rose both at an

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: instant, and fought a long hour by Shrewsbury clock. If I may be

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: believed, so; if not, let them that should reward valour bear the sin

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: upon their own heads. I’ll take it upon my death, I gave him this wound

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: in the thigh. If the man were alive, and would deny it, zounds, I would

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: make him eat a piece of my sword.

lines.speaker: LANCASTER
lines.text: This is the strangest tale that ever I heard.

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: This is the strangest fellow, brother John.—

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: Come, bring your luggage nobly on your back.

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: For my part, if a lie may do thee grace,

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: I’ll gild it with the happiest terms I have.
[_A retreat is sounded._]

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: The trumpet sounds retreat; the day is ours.

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: Come, brother, let us to the highest of the field,

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: To see what friends are living, who are dead.
[_Exeunt Prince Henry and Lancaster._]

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: I’ll follow, as they say, for reward. He that rewards me, God reward

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: him! If I do grow great, I’ll grow less, for I’ll purge, and leave

lines.speaker: FALSTAFF
lines.text: sack, and live cleanly as a nobleman should do.
[_Exit, bearing off the body._]
The trumpets sound. Enter King Henry, Prince Henry, Lancaster, Westmoreland and others, with Worcester and Vernon prisoners.

lines.speaker: KING
lines.text: Thus ever did rebellion find rebuke.

lines.speaker: KING
lines.text: Ill-spirited Worcester, did not we send grace,

lines.speaker: KING
lines.text: Pardon, and terms of love to all of you?

lines.speaker: KING
lines.text: And wouldst thou turn our offers contrary?

lines.speaker: KING
lines.text: Misuse the tenour of thy kinsman’s trust?

lines.speaker: KING
lines.text: Three knights upon our party slain today,

lines.speaker: KING
lines.text: A noble earl, and many a creature else,

lines.speaker: KING
lines.text: Had been alive this hour,

lines.speaker: KING
lines.text: If, like a Christian, thou hadst truly borne

lines.speaker: KING
lines.text: Betwixt our armies true intelligence.

lines.speaker: WORCESTER
lines.text: What I have done my safety urged me to;

lines.speaker: WORCESTER
lines.text: And I embrace this fortune patiently,

lines.speaker: WORCESTER
lines.text: Since not to be avoided it falls on me.

lines.speaker: KING
lines.text: Bear Worcester to the death, and Vernon too.

lines.speaker: KING
lines.text: Other offenders we will pause upon.
[_Exeunt Worcester and Vernon, guarded._]

lines.speaker: KING
lines.text: How goes the field?

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: The noble Scot, Lord Douglas, when he saw

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: The fortune of the day quite turn’d from him,

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: The noble Percy slain, and all his men

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: Upon the foot of fear, fled with the rest,

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: And, falling from a hill, he was so bruised

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: That the pursuers took him. At my tent

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: The Douglas is, and I beseech your Grace

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: I may dispose of him.

lines.speaker: KING
lines.text: With all my heart.

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: Then, brother John of Lancaster, to you

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: This honourable bounty shall belong.

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: Go to the Douglas and deliver him

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: Up to his pleasure, ransomless and free.

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: His valours shown upon our crests today

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: Hath taught us how to cherish such high deeds,

lines.speaker: PRINCE
lines.text: Even in the bosom of our adversaries.

lines.speaker: LANCASTER
lines.text: I thank your Grace for this high courtesy,

lines.speaker: LANCASTER
lines.text: Which I shall give away immediately.

lines.speaker: KING
lines.text: Then this remains, that we divide our power.

lines.speaker: KING
lines.text: You, son John, and my cousin Westmoreland,

lines.speaker: KING
lines.text: Towards York shall bend you with your dearest speed

lines.speaker: KING
lines.text: To meet Northumberland and the prelate Scroop,

lines.speaker: KING
lines.text: Who, as we hear, are busily in arms.

lines.speaker: KING
lines.text: Myself and you, son Harry, will towards Wales,

lines.speaker: KING
lines.text: To fight with Glendower and the Earl of March.

lines.speaker: KING
lines.text: Rebellion in this land shall lose his sway,

lines.speaker: KING
lines.text: Meeting the check of such another day,

lines.speaker: KING
lines.text: And since this business so fair is done,

lines.speaker: KING
lines.text: Let us not leave till all our own be won.
[_Exeunt._]
